title: Archive/Rotate Old Logs
description: Tars and gzips log files older than N days out of a directory into a timestamped archive, optionally deleting the originals after a successful archive -- for logs that aren't already covered by logrotate.

variables.name: MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.prompt: Archive files older than this many days

variables.name: ARCHIVE_DIR
variables.prompt: Directory to write the .tar.gz archive into

toggles.name: DELETE_ORIGINALS
toggles.prompt: Delete the original files after a successful archive
